name: legitimate_notices
title: Legitimate bank and delivery notices
description: Genuine alerts, one-time-password warnings, delivery and card notices. None should link; several cite the same public helpline, which counter-evidence must not treat as a shared actor.

checks.name: I1: an observed match needs exactly equal identifiers
I2: behaviour alone never creates an observed match
I4: every campaign is an unreviewed hypothesis

disclaimer: Synthetic scenario replayed through the real pipeline in an isolated, throwaway database. A linked group is only a hypothesis for an analyst to review, not an established finding, and nothing here is evidence about a real person or organisation.
